heading: This Afternoon
text: Partly to mostly sunny. Highs in the upper to 70s to lower 80s in the south, and in the Champlain and northern Connecticut valleys, mid to upper 70s elsewhere north. West winds 10 to 20 mph, gusting to 30 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Clouds variable early, decreasing late. Chance of an early sprinkle in the northern mountains. Lows from the mid 40s to around 50, except low to mid 50s far south, and in the Champlain Valley. Northwest winds 5 to 15 mph.

heading: Friday
text: Partly to mostly sunny. Valley highs in the mid to upper 60s north, and upper 60s to mid 70s in the south. Northwest winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph east of the Greens.
